subject: english
question:
Read the sentence given below and identify if there is an error in it. The error can be in any segment of the sentence. The segments are marked A, B, C, and D. Select option D if there is 'No error'.

(A) Ritika angrily 

(B) spoke to Kartik 

(C) after the meeting

(D) No error.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **"Ritika angrily spoke to Kartik after the meeting"** is grammatically correct.
 
• The structure follows the proper order: **Subject + Adverb + Verb + Object + Time expression**.
 
• There is no issue related to tense, preposition, or word usage in any part.
 
• Thus, no segment (A, B, or C) contains an error.

Therefore, the correct answer is **D (No error)**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Ritika angrily spoke to Kartik after the meeting."*
